requirements: PHP version compatible with Laravel version
HTTPS certificate for web and API
deployment_steps: Create a MySQL database and user on the hosting panel.
Set the API document root to backend/public; do not expose backend, storage, or vendor as the document root.
Upload the backend application files, excluding local .env and development-only files.
Run composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader when Composer is available, or upload the vendor directory produced by the same command.
Copy .env.example to .env and set APP_ENV=production, APP_DEBUG=false, APP_URL, database values, and a generated APP_KEY.
Run php artisan migrate --force and php artisan storage:link, then clear and cache configuration with php artisan optimize.
Build the web application with npm run build and upload the contents of web/dist to the web document root.
Set VITE_API_URL to the HTTPS API URL before building the web application.
Verify the public API, a deep-linked React route, authentication, image storage, and a database-backed request.
post_deploy_checks: GET https://api.example.com/api/trucks returns JSON without a server error.
Opening https://example.com/trucks directly and refreshing it returns the React application.
Login, image upload, storage URLs, and a test order work over HTTPS.
APP_DEBUG is false and no .env file is present in the web document root.
